name: Sheraton Carlsbad Resort & Spa
lede: On a 120-seat patio facing the Pacific, fifteen Platinum Gas heaters have warmed sunset dinners since 2008. When parts wore after twelve coastal years, Bromic replaced the components, not the heaters.

hero.caption: Platinum Gas on drop poles behind the fire feature at night. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: The dining terrace at dusk. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The 209-room resort’s Twenty/20 Grill & Wine Bar has an outdoor patio for 120 guests overlooking the Pacific, where diners come for the sunset.
Coastal breezes make evenings chilly. After about twelve years on the coast, the heaters showed wear, and the hotel needed parts fast – without the time and cost of replacing every heater.

Fifteen Platinum Smart-Heat Gas heaters were installed in 2008. Their modular design meant only critical components – from inside the control module to the ignition wires and burners – had to be exchanged.

quote.text: Guests love to sit in this area especially during dinner to view the setting sun over the Pacific Ocean while dining.
